pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, dark-brown polygons with high-angularity edges and dendritic protrusions. Edge gradients transition from dark to light with moderate sharpness. Patch size varies from large, centralized units on the mid-flank to smaller, fragmented clusters on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Wide, cream-colored negative-space network. Pathways exhibit variable pixel thickness and form a continuous graph. Junction nodes are prominently defined, frequently manifesting as three-to-five-way intersections across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette formed by the dark mane along the neck and shoulder ridge. The 1D contour shows consistent, short vertical protrusions against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, dark-toned avian silhouette perched on the upper dorsal neck, creating a localized occlusion of the pelage pattern.
